overall settings.title: Aegis
overall settings.description: Protect against threats to subjects of the realm through ⚔️{SandyBrown|auto battle.}

attribs.name: Bounty
attribs.description: How much you can earn by defeating this menace.

attribs.name: HP
attribs.description: How many hits the character can take and still keep going. Those without HP could be dead, lying gravely wounded, captured, or simply out of the fight.

attribs.name: Shooting against Castle
attribs.description: Shooting at opponents who are fortified in the castle is more difficult.

items.name: Distance
items.description: How far away the two parties are. Melee attacks require close range.

items.name: 🛡️Jewelled Shield
items.description: Rare drop. Chance to be found on the ground in the **Ravine** from bandit loot.

items.name: 🗡️Lance
items.description: Excellent for charging on horseback, terrible when wielded on foot.

items.name: Times Defended Castle
items.description: How many times you've successfully defended the castle.

locations.name: 🏰Castle
locations.description: Tower Defense: Open *auto battle* and press *start battle.*

locations.name: Ravine
locations.description:
The knights patrol chases bandits who have been using this area to rob the town.
If the bandits get away by increasing **Distance** enough, then **Aegis** cannot continue the fight, showing their hit points as 0 even though no health is lost.

locations.name: 🍺Tavern
locations.description: Where mercenaries can be hired from.

locations.name: 🌳Woods
locations.description: After reports of wolves frightening young girls, a bounty has been offered for each pelt.

characters.name: Ivanhoe
characters.description: King Richard's best knight who returned with him from the crusades.

characters.name: Merc 3
characters.description: Expensive mercenary archer, so he must be the best.

characters.name: Siegeman Climber 1
characters.description: Single-minded melee fighter whose only goal is to move up to the castle and start hitting.

characters.name: Tristan
characters.description: Famously dueled with Lancelot and neither could prevail, so the contest ended in a draw.

events.name: Drop — Bandit
events.description: The threshold adjustment makes it so there is a 15% chance of major success (105 or higher).

effects.label: End the fight by wiping HP

events.name: Hire Mercenary
events.description:
Make sure you have enough *💍Jewels* for the *Hire Price* shown under *Modifiers.*

After hiring, set party to **Aegis** and travel to **🏰Castle** only.

events.name: Lance
events.description: Run down enemies on a horse with a lance, using movement speed to increase damage.

determinants.label: Harder to land accurately at speed
